AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#672 @ e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/2/1

Independent full-depth T4 audit of T2 only: entire 12-file / 1,328-line piece diff, coach create/update/publish trial rules, client-scoped offers, DTO/controller/module boundaries, notification preferences, email rendering, the complete notice worker and its concurrency/recovery paths. [Candidate and landing contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5975772636)

### Prior findings first

**B-656-3 closes at its previously reported missing-notice pagination boundary:** reconciliation now keyset-pages by `(trial_ends_at,id)` rather than filtering only the first page, with a bounded resumable sweep; independent 120-row/equal-end and concurrent-reconciliation controls pass at this exact source. [Reconciler](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts) [Executed controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173068713)

**B-656-5 closes at the failed-read boundary:** card authority remains tri-state, unknown records/sends nothing rather than a no-charge guarantee, channels spend no delivery attempts, and recovery produces the correct charge copy; independent record-time and delivery-time failures both pass. [Card authority and deferral](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts) [Executed controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173068713)

**B-656-7 closes for T2's direct notice-worker log/error mappings:** arbitrary error names and push codes go through the inherited closed helpers; actual notice-catch canary controls pass, with no claim that unrelated preexisting transport logging was redesigned. [Notice worker](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts) [Executed diagnostic controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173068713)

Previously closed B-656-2's fresh-lease/staggered-entry boundary and B-656-4's delivery-time global mute remain fixed, with push suppression separated from billing email; B-672-1 below is a newly exercised **late claim clock** failure, not a duplicate of the original attempt-counter finding. [Prior dispositions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/656#issuecomment-5972091723) [Independent fresh-lease and mute controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173068713)

B-656-6's conflict-worker alert transition belongs to T3, not this verdict. [Split ownership](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672)

### B-672-1 — channel leases use the sweep's stale start time, allowing overlapping provider sends

**File:line:** `src/packages/trials/trial-notice.service.ts:378–399,499–500,519,585,634–659`. [Sweep, delivery and claim](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts)

The single `now` captured at sweep/reconcile entry is passed through every serial delivery; each later channel still sets `lease_until = oldNow + 120 seconds`, rather than 120 seconds from its actual claim. [Lease clock](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts)

**Executed counterexample:** two earlier rows each spend 29 seconds on push and 29 seconds on email, all below the 30-second transport bound; the third push starts at sweep time +116 seconds but receives a lease ending at +120 seconds. [Refined clock probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173294509)

Five seconds into that third push, a second service instance at the fresh time +121 seconds claims the supposedly expired lease and sends the same purchase's push concurrently, producing **two sends instead of one** before the first transport's deadline. [Executed lease failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173294509)

Fenced outcome writes still prevent stale state overwrite, but do not prevent this overlapping send; explicitly at-least-once crash recovery does not justify a healthy claim that starts nearly expired or already expired. [Completion versus claim](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts)

**Minimal fix rule:** calculate eligibility and lease expiration from a fresh clock at each actual channel claim, never the batch snapshot; retain token fencing and bounded transport, and prevent dispatch when preparation has already exhausted ownership.

**Verification:** retain the late-row concurrent-replica probe for push and email, including slow earlier deliveries/reconciliation, while retaining the passing fresh-lease and stale-outcome controls.

### B-672-2 — terminal pending notices permanently consume the delivery sweep's first page

**File:line:** `src/packages/trials/trial-notice.service.ts:316–331,386–399`. [Delivery admission and skip](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts)

The delivery sweep selects the oldest 50 pending notices without paging/progress, while `deliver()` returns for missing/canceled purchases without settling their channels or moving their eligibility; those same rows can occupy every subsequent batch until their notice end. [Selection and early return](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts)

**Executed counterexample:** 50 old notices whose purchases were canceled, followed by one healthy already-recorded pending notice, all with the same future trial end; two successive sweeps make **zero pushes/emails for the healthy 51st row**, whose channels remain pending, and reconciliation cannot rescue it because its notice already exists. [Executed fairness failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173068713) [Refined proof bundle](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173294509)

This is distinct from the fixed missing-notice reconciler pagination: it loses delivery of an existing durable obligation after post-commit loss/restart. [Reconciliation and retry loops](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Ftrials%2Ftrial-notice.service.ts)

**Minimal fix rule:** give terminal/inapplicable obligations a durable terminal disposition and make retry admission fair through bounded deterministic paging or equivalent eligibility/progress; unknown-card, live-lease and repeatedly skipped rows must not permanently hide eligible later notices.

**Verification:** keep the 51-row regression, add more-than-one-page unknown-card/live-lease prefixes, and verify that later healthy rows are delivered without inventing card absence or discarding recoverable obligations.

### C-672-1 — retained composed-candidate gate, formerly C-656-1

**File:line / ownership:** `src/packages/packages.module.ts:49–66`, the exported capability and trial services; exact recurring-plus-trials wiring remains owed by the second stack to land, including real capability registration, reservation/release, unified entitlement and composed tests, followed by backend-first mobile #338 deployment and configured trial-ending webhook event. [Module seam](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Fpackages.module.ts) [Prior integration carry](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/656#issuecomment-5972091723) [Deployment pairing](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672)

This is not a new standalone T2 blocker or a checkout approval; #672/#675's shared packages.service/controller refresh belongs to whichever lands second and does not block this piece's review. [Operator ruling](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5975772636)

### Evidence, remaining review and CI

No approved-code audit evidence is reused: original #656 never received this lens's APPROVE; every T2 line was reviewed fresh, while byte-identical original round-5 regression results were checked as behavioral evidence only. [Prior verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/656#issuecomment-5972091723) [Before: 8 failed / 31 passed](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37144505127) [After: 96/96](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37144528941)

Coach trial input remains 0–30 days with free/one-time/companion refusals and merged PATCH validation, trial-only edits preserve pricing caches/locks, client offers use authenticated client/coach scope, unregistered capability does not advertise a trial, and the module imports no later-piece worker. [Package service](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Fpackages.service.ts) [Client/controller boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Fpackages.controller.ts) [Module](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e06b5b13691d3f869b92009c87159c0672df517c/src%2Fpackages%2Fpackages.module.ts)

Applicable candidate checks, including build/test, all three live suites, RLS floor, audit and schema parity, are green; CodeQL/danger/banned-casts/SBOM remain main-only landing checks for this stacked piece, not executed successes here. [Candidate CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37148200663) [Audit](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37148200640) [Parity](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37148200627) [Main-only check ruling](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5975772636)

Independent CI is deliberately red: initial proof **2 failed / 51 controls passed**, refined proof **2 failed / 8 controls passed**; actual trial services ran against constraint-aware synthetic tables/transports, not a live Stripe/provider or database concurrency environment. [Initial exact-source proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173068713) [Refined proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37173294509)

No PR-branch edits, merge, production/provider action or local heavy command; land only the fully qualified trials stack as one and deploy after T3.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#672 @ 6ce54002226a957fa612e5cdfced7c9cf12a71fc — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES
A/B/C = 0/2/1

Reviewer: agent 117, job AUD-SOL-T12-117; independent full-depth T4 audit of T2, base `c75002c9eef3ebc4dd7c41d537fc38028635e4dc`; every line of the 14-file / 2,371-line piece reviewed, including all package CRUD/HTTP/DTO/module changes, notification/email additions, the complete 942-line notice worker and all tests. [Candidate and composition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5976969216)

### Prior findings first

**Sol B-672-1 closes at the late-claim clock boundary:** sweep/reconciliation advance the caller clock, each channel claim gets a fresh lease, and insufficient remaining lease room returns the unused attempt without dispatch; both the retained independent late-row counterexample and builder push/email/preparation regressions pass. [Fix](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5976569283) [Independent exact-source run](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37182554631)

**Sol B-672-2 closes:** canceled/missing obligations receive terminal `skipped` channel states, and deterministic `(created_at,id)` keyset paging lets healthy notices behind unknown-card/live-lease prefixes progress; independent canceled-prefix and candidate multi-page controls pass. [Fix](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5976569283) [Executed controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37182554631)

Builder round-6 before **11 failed / 24 passed**, after **74/74**, and round-7 composition before **6 failed / 4 passed** and **8 failed / 2 passed**, after **247/247**, were verified from actual logs; the #675 overlap keeps both idempotent creation/fingerprints and trial input/storage/validation. [Round-6 before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37174499909) [Round-6 after](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37174803961) [T2-only resolution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37179924220) [Main-only controller](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37179934691) [Composed success](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37179946404)

Original **B-656-3/5/7 remain closed at the reported pagination/unknown-card/direct-worker-diagnostic boundaries**; independent exact-source controls also retain fresh-lease and delivery-time mute behavior from B-656-2/4, but do not prove the previously unexercised real email transport boundary below. [Prior dispositions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5976081090) [Executed controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37182554631)

No approved-code audit evidence is reused: original #656 and predecessor T2 had no Sol APPROVE; full current source was independently read, rather than carrying an approval from another lens or from a passing builder test. [Original Sol verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/656#issuecomment-5972091723) [Predecessor T2 verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5976081090)

### B-672-3 — pending obligations are dispatched for a superseded or already-ended trial

**File:line:** `src/packages/trials/trial-notice.service.ts:372–416,417–434,743–768`; delivery selects current purchase status but omits its current `trial_ends_at`/access, refuses only `canceled`, uses the notice's old end, and channel admission does not test the trial deadline. [Delivery/admission diff](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672/files)

**Executed counterexamples:** a durable Oct-12 notice whose subscription was extended to Oct 14 still emits the old Oct-12 charge push; an old future notice whose purchase is now `active` with its trial already ended also dispatches an upcoming-trial warning; when a valid trial ends in 20 seconds and push takes 29 seconds (inside the 30-second bound), email is nevertheless started nine seconds after the trial ends. [Three acceptance failures](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37182554631)

These are reachable lifecycle inputs, not forged endpoint parameters: T3's subscription event path updates `ClientPurchase.trial_ends_at`, while notice identity is `(purchase_id,trial_ends_at)` and old durable obligations survive a lost post-commit delivery; this finding belongs to T2's delivery eligibility, not a request to change T3. [T3 lifecycle context](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673) [Notice schema/worker contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672/files)

**Minimal fix rule:** validate that an obligation still describes the purchase's current started, unended trial before dispatch; durably retire superseded/ended obligations and recheck deadline/eligibility at each actual channel admission, including email after push preparation. Preserve current-trial cancellation-at-period-end notices and removed-card truth; do not discard a still-valid no-charge trial notice.

**Verification:** retain the extension, early-paid-transition and push-crossing-deadline failing tests, add canonical-new-notice delivery and same-end canceled-at-period-end/no-card controls, and verify retired rows cannot consume retry admission.

### B-672-4 — a bounded email await is not a bounded provider operation

**File:line:** `src/packages/trials/trial-notice.service.ts:698–725,733–736,923–941`, reached through `src/email/email.service.ts:208–215,349–356`; `withTimeout` races the await, but email supplies no timeout cancellation, `EmailService` supplies no fetch signal/deadline, and the timeout completion clears the channel lease while that actual send continues. [New worker caller](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672/files)

**Executed counterexample:** the real `TrialNoticeService` calls the real `EmailService`/Resend transport against an intercepted synthetic fetch; the first provider request is held, the 30-second wrapper times out and clears the lease, then a retry sends with `:a2` while the first request remains in flight. [Real-service transport probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37182554631)

Observed **two requests, peak two simultaneous provider operations, no signal on either**; the probe resolves the first request for cleanup, and performs no outbound network or provider action. [Executed request/overlap failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37182554631)

The affected behavior is the new worker's decision to release/retry an operation it has not actually bounded, not an unrelated demand to redesign historical email logging; an outage can accumulate still-running requests across all attempts, and the worker's stated non-overlap guarantee is false. [Caller retry/guarantee](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672/files)

**Minimal fix rule:** bound the actual email operation through an abortable/deadlined transport and propagate cancellation to fetch; do not relinquish ownership/start a different attempt while a controllable earlier local send continues. Retain honest at-least-once semantics for a remote acceptance whose outcome is unknown, and use provider idempotency or equivalent reconciliation where necessary rather than claiming exactly-once.

**Verification:** keep the real EmailService/intercepted-fetch test; cover stalled provider, timeout, canceled-before-fetch, slow preparation and successful retry, asserting bounded in-flight lifetime and no overlapping controllable local sends.

### C-672-1 — existing recurring/trials integrated-candidate gate retained

**File:line:** `src/packages/packages.module.ts:49–68` and its exported capability/usage/notice seam; the second stack to land still owes #680 composition (one reservation ledger, stale-release path, capability registration, server-side trial parameters and unified webhook state), mobile #338 pairing and configured trial-ending webhook event. [Prior carry](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5976081090) [Current builder integration carry](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5976969216)

This remains outside this piece's standalone review, not a new blocker or live-checkout approval; the #675 package-file composition is now present and tested rather than still owed. [Round-7 composition evidence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37179946404)

### Evidence and CI boundaries

Independent test-only child `7a505ced226b2c07686896313542b4a8cfd0d224` preserves candidate source/schema/dependency inputs; workflow receipt `02f5f263618f86e6f6391a7fb37728336b65d058` executes **four deliberate acceptance failures / 77 controls passing** (66 candidate tests, 11 independent passing controls), with no fixture/type failure counted as defect evidence. [Independent exact-source proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37182554631)

Applicable candidate checks are green at `6ce54002`; main-only CodeQL/danger/banned-casts/SBOM have not run on this stacked base and remain landing gates, while deploy-readiness skips by policy. [Candidate CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37179964952) [Main-only applicability](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5976969216)

No PR-branch edits, merge, production/provider action or local heavy execution; land the fully qualified trials stack as one only after material findings close.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#672 @ c5e7ed8e35f1e5b88653e5605dded2af8614182d — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/1/1

Reviewer: agent 118, job AUD-SOL-T23-118; independent T4 audit of the full 15-file / 2,977-line T2 piece and round-8 delta, including package CRUD/HTTP/DTO/module boundaries, notification/email additions, the complete notice worker and its tests. [Candidate and round 8](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5977736892)

### Prior findings first

**B-672-4 closes at its reported provider-lifetime boundary:** cancellation reaches the real EmailService/Resend fetch, a stopped operation releases ownership, an abort-ignoring operation retains/renews its fenced lease, and a stable content-bound provider key survives ordinary retries; the retained real-service/intercepted-fetch counterexample and candidate abort/replica controls pass. [Transport and lease fix](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5977736892) [Independent execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218265800)

**B-672-3 improves but remains narrowly open at actual push admission:** already-superseded/ended/unstarted obligations retire correctly, and email re-preparation after a push crossing the deadline passes; the two additional committed-state races below still dispatch the old warning. [Round-8 lifecycle controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/c5e7ed8e35f1e5b88653e5605dded2af8614182d/test/b-trials-t2-fix-round-8.spec.ts) [Executed acceptance failures](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218265800)

[Prior Sol dispositions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5977306071) [Independent replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218265800)

[Before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37185289635) [After](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37185318643)

### B-672-3 — narrowed: a committed extension/cancellation during push preparation still emits obsolete charge copy

**File:line:** `src/packages/trials/trial-notice.service.ts:496–530,716–753,904–915`; `prepare()` checks the purchase and builds immutable copy, then the push claims a lease and awaits `getPreferences()`, while `admit()` checks only the old notice deadline and lease room—not current purchase eligibility/card/cancel facts. [Preparation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/c5e7ed8e35f1e5b88653e5605dded2af8614182d/src/packages/trials/trial-notice.service.ts#L496-L530) [Push admission](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/c5e7ed8e35f1e5b88653e5605dded2af8614182d/src/packages/trials/trial-notice.service.ts#L716-L753) [Admission predicate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/c5e7ed8e35f1e5b88653e5605dded2af8614182d/src/packages/trials/trial-notice.service.ts#L904-L926)

**Executed counterexamples, real TrialNoticeService with constraint-aware synthetic tables/transports:** (1) a subscription extension commits during the normal preference await, moving the purchase's trial end from Oct 12 to Oct 14; **one Oct-12 charge push is still dispatched**, although the subsequent email preparation retires the old notice; (2) a cancel-at-period-end commit during that same await still dispatches **“Your card will be charged $49 then”**, despite current cancel state requiring the no-charge copy. [Both behavioral failures](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218265800)

These are committed webhook-state changes before provider dispatch, not a demand to retract an already-sent notification or eliminate an unavoidable remote race; neither operation timed out, lost ownership or crossed the original trial deadline. [Executed inputs and observations](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218265800)

**Minimal fix rule:** refresh current-trial eligibility and charge/cancel/card copy at the actual channel admission boundary after asynchronous preparation, under the same fenced ownership; retire superseded/terminal work and avoid dispatching a snapshot invalidated during preferences/card/zone preparation.

**Verification:** retain both new tests, add removal/deletion/early-paid changes during preparation, and keep current-trial cancel/no-card, mute, lease-room, transport-abort, fairness and deadline controls passing.

### C-672-1 — recurring/trials integrated-candidate gate retained

`src/packages/packages.module.ts:49–68` exports the trial capability/usage/notice seam; the second stack to land still owes the #680 composition list (one reservation ledger, stale-release path, capability registration, typed trial parameters and unified webhook state), mobile #338 pairing and configured `customer.subscription.trial_will_end`. [Existing integration carry](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5977306071) [Builder landing contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5977778572)

This is a landing condition, not a new standalone blocker or live recurring-checkout approval; #675's keyed-create and trial-field composition is present and its real-HTTP candidate tests pass. [Composed HTTP tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/c5e7ed8e35f1e5b88653e5605dded2af8614182d/test/b-trials-t2-idempotent-create-http.spec.ts) [Executed controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218265800)

### Evidence, size and CI

No approved-code evidence is reused: original #656 and preceding T2 heads had no Sol APPROVE; the full current piece was read independently. [Original Sol verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/656#issuecomment-5972091723) [Preceding T2 verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/672#issuecomment-5977306071)

Independent test-only child `8fe53f9e418eca8b2f06058b6e065417509e79fa` is based on T3 `df76889fb862095170498dccb23f35db3d116690`; every T2 production source/schema/dependency input is byte-identical to this T2 head, and workflow receipt `243cb9e95ffc8804cf019b076c78002b783b7288` adds only the targeted lane files. [Exact-source execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37218265800)
